title: 1:1 prep — Arjun Rao (IC3) — Apr 2 2026
content:
Context: Arjun is mid-sprint on kv-cache improvements (workstream: reduce p95 for long-tail seqs). Oncall this week (Thu-Fri). Wants to discuss career leveling and next growth steps; also buried in perf flakiness from quantized kernels.

Goals for this 1:1 (30m):
- 5m: quick personal check-in (burnout, bandwidth)
- 10m: technical sync: recent perf numbers, failing benchmarks, infra blockers
- 8m: career discussion: IC3 -> IC4 expectations + concrete signals to target
- 7m: agree action items, dates, and followups

Quick notes / reminders to self:
- Bring up oncall load: Arjun said pager was noisy on Wed; check incident SRV-1987 notes before call.
- Review GH PR #452 (kv-cache async flush) prior to meeting; annotate two spots: cache eviction logic + unit test edge case.
- Ask about time estimate to finish eval harness (should be <2 days ideally).

What I expect to hear from Arjun:
- Current blocker: quantized kernel mismatch (error spike at step ~120) — needs repro machine and INFRA GPU access.
- Estimate: baseline patch + tests by Apr 8, but needs infra help for full repro.
- Career: wants more architect-level exposure (design reviews, cross-team TODOs).

Notes to capture during the meeting:
- Perf: p95 for 2048 tokens has improved from 380ms -> 312ms after async flush (local bench). Need CI reproducible run (compare against conda38).
- Failing tests: fuzz harness shows nondeterministic failure: seed 42, step 119. Failure looks like KV cache pointer invalidation after quantize path.
- Oncall: Pager noise due to noisy replica on i-0abcd; Ops already rotated, but Arjun suggests tuning alert thresholds.

Career / growth points to discuss:
- Concrete tasks to demonstrate ownership: lead rollout of kv-cache v0.2 (drive canary + metrics), run postmortem for recent perf incident, mentor junior on batching heuristics.
- Evidence for IC4: cross-team influence, owning rollout plan end-to-end, measurable impact (>10% unit cost reduction or >15% p95 improvement on targeted workloads).
- Short-term growth actions: present design in Eng Tech Review (book slot), pair with Maya on kernel selection logic, document quantization experiments.

Action items (decide owners + due dates):
A1. Arjun: attach failing reproducer and minimal repro steps to JIRA INFRA-67 (deadline 2026-04-04).
A2. Lina: ping Infra SRE (Maya) about ephemeral GPU access and link to INFRA-67 (deadline 2026-04-03).
A3. Arjun: add CI benchmark job entry + baseline numbers to confluence:serving-runtime/kv-cache-eval (deadline 2026-04-08).
A4. Lina & Arjun: schedule 60m design review for kv-cache v0.2 canary plan (week of Apr 12) and invite platform + ops.
A5. Arjun: draft a short mentoring plan for junior engineer (KPI: review 4 PRs / month) and share by 2026-04-10.
A6. Lina: follow up on career rubric examples for IC4 and email examples to Arjun (deadline 2026-04-06).

Follow-ups to check next 1:1: repro attached to INFRA-67, CI baseline committed, mentor plan shared, confirmation of design review slot.

Unresolved questions to raise if time allows:
- Are current alert thresholds tuned for realistic long-tail workloads? (Ops input: need traffic sample)
- Is there appetite to prioritize a small allocation of dedicated GPUs for quantization experiments on Dedicated pool? (cost tradeoffs)

Random notes / off-record to self:
- Keep tone constructive — highlight wins (p95 improvement) before delving into blockers.
- Offer to block 1 hour for pairing on repro if Arjun gets stuck (signals support).
- If career talk goes deep, propose follow-up 30m with career rubric + manager examples.

Last-minute prep checklist (before starting the call):
- Open GH PR #452 and leave two inline comments (eviction logic + test)
- Skim SRV-1987 incident notes
- Pull CI baseline numbers and have them ready in chat (p95/throughput)
- Have INFRA-67 link ready to paste

End-of-doc: quick log for after the call: capture what Arjun commits to, update this doc, mark actions done and move to team notes if final.
